title: <What the PR does>: review results
subtitle: One sentence on what the page gives the reader.
howto: This page gives the results of a review of PR #12345. The review examined commit abcdef12.

Each section of the report starts with a summary of its patterns. Some summaries have a diagram, where red shows the problem and green shows an approved fix. Select + to show the findings of a section, and + next to a finding to show its details.
A Required finding must be corrected before this PR ships.
A Requested finding . The review asks you to correct it.
An Optional finding occurs in the same way without this PR. You do not have to correct it in this PR.
Most findings have a failing test. Each test name is a link to the code of the test.
The other tabs contain the reviewer reports, the code of the tests, and the base-commit checks.
copy_intro: This text contains the full review of PR #12345 (commit abcdef12): the final report, the reviewer reports, the code of the failing tests, and the base-commit checks with their evidence files.

views.title: Specification rules
intro: These documents quote the parts of the specification that the findings refer to.

items.summary: Clients must send the resource parameter in authorization and token requests.

views.title: Reviewer reports
intro: These are the reports of the reviewers. Each reviewer examined one perspective and ran code in its own REPL.
The box at the top of each report shows the final result of each finding from that report.

views.title: Test code
intro: These pages contain the code of the tests that this review added. Each page is one test file and shows only the code that this review added.
Each test asserts the correct behavior and fails on the reviewed commit.
views.patch_summary: This patch contains every test that this review added. Apply it to the reviewed commit to run the tests.

views.title: Proposed changes
intro: These pages contain source changes that this review proposes and verified, but did not apply.

proposals.summary: One paragraph in ASD-STE100: what the patch changes and how the review verified it.

views.title: Alternate design
intro: This tab is a proposal for discussion, not a finding.

items.summary: One paragraph in ASD-STE100. It says that the design is a proposal, not a finding.

views.title: Base-commit checks
intro: These reports compare each proven finding with the base commit, before the PR. The labels in the report come from these results.
